scene: You glide off the glowing solar-sail junk onto the lively harbour pier.
picture: Flat side-view across a timber pier over jade-green water. On the far left sits a low floating tea barge. Left of centre rests the moored solar junk with glowing panels. You stand centre-right in a red bomber jacket and white roller skates beside a brass directory board. A tall pagoda lighthouse rises on the far right.
shown: a floating wooden tea barge moored on the water on the far left
a carved brass directory board mounted on a post at the centre
an arched wooden doorway at the base of the pagoda lighthouse on the far right
